Layout: Arrangement of text. rendah: title bottom-left, corner telemetry. center: centred title. poster: huge title top-left. minimal: small title. data: heavy telemetry.
Title: Title text, one line per row. A line starting with * is bold, others regular. Typing \n also makes a line break.
Titlesize: Title font size as a fraction of frame height; layouts scale it further.
Telemetry: Show the corner read-outs (timecode, frame counter, random number columns).
Telesize: Size multiplier for the telemetry text.
Telelines: Number of rows in the random number column block (1-16).
Tickrate: How many times per second the random telemetry numbers change.
Fps: Frame rate used for the timecode and frame counter display.
Marks: Show the crop marks in the corners.
Border: Show a thin border line around the frame.
Edgeticks: Show small ruler ticks along the frame edges.
Crosshair: Show a small cross at the centre of the frame.
Borderwidth: Line thickness of the frame graphics in pixels.
Margin: Inset of text and frame graphics from the edge, as a fraction of frame height.
Textcolor: Colour of the text and frame graphics.
Accent: Use Accentcolor for the REC dot and top-left crop mark. Off draws them in Textcolor.
Accentcolor: Colour of the REC dot and top-left crop mark when Accent is on.
Modamount: Strength of the modulation CHOP on sizes: band1 scales the title, band2 the telemetry.
Mix: Blend between the base image (0) and the image with overlay (1).
Bypass: Output the base image only (in1 or black) without the overlay.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
